items.headline: Warriors Ink Brandin Podziemski to Five-Year, $110M Extension
items.summary: Golden State Warriors guard Brandin Podziemski has agreed to a five-year rookie-scale contract extension worth $110 million, securing his future with the team through the 2031-32 season. The deal comes after Podziemski appeared in all 82 games last season, averaging 13.8 points, 5.1 rebounds, 3.7 assists, and 1.08 steals per contest.

items.headline: Suns Edge Spurs in Preseason Clash
items.summary: The Phoenix Suns defeated the San Antonio Spurs 102-98 in a Saturday night preseason game. Victor Wembanyama showcased his improved playmaking for the Spurs, dishing out six assists in 22 minutes.

items.headline: Warriors Outlast Kings in Preseason Battle
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors secured a 111-106 victory over the Sacramento Kings in their preseason matchup on Saturday.

items.headline: Rockets and Mavericks Split China Series
items.summary: The Houston Rockets and Dallas Mavericks split their two-game preseason series in Macao, China. The Mavericks dropped one outing to Houston with a score of 117-135. Their second matchup took place early this morning.

items.headline: Wemby's Playmaking Shines for Spurs
items.summary: Victor Wembanyama demonstrated strong playmaking abilities in the Spurs' preseason loss to the Suns, recording a team-high six assists along with 13 points, seven rebounds, and two blocks in just 22 minutes.

items.headline: Podziemski Delivers in Preseason Win
items.summary: Brandin Podziemski contributed 18 points, three 3-pointers, seven rebounds, and four assists in 26 minutes during the Warriors' 111-106 preseason win against the Sacramento Kings.

items.headline: Magic Face Cavaliers in Cleveland
items.summary: The Orlando Magic, coming off a preseason win, will visit the Cleveland Cavaliers at Rocket Arena tonight. This game is scheduled for 6:30 PM ET and will be broadcast on ESPN.

items.headline: Bucks Travel to Charlotte for Preseason Matchup
items.summary: The Milwaukee Bucks will take on the Charlotte Hornets tonight at the Spectrum Center. Tip-off is set for 7:00 PM ET.

items.headline: Bulls and Nuggets Square Off in Denver
items.summary: The Chicago Bulls head to Ball Arena to face the Denver Nuggets in a preseason contest scheduled for 9:00 PM ET on ESPN.
